I’ll commit to 15 tons today and donate the full $15,000 directly to the clinic. I care about keeping this lake healthy for our families, and I also want our neighbors to get the treatment they need today.

I agree to the recovery limits: no more than 6 tons next month, then 10 tons each month once the lake is back at capacity, with catches kept public. Let’s record those limits alongside today’s donations so this remains a one-time exception.

Kate, you’re the last to confirm—can you commit to both?
